newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch handler wants to invest 15mlm fls at Ostend.
newsitem.headline: Dutch handler wants to invest 15mlm fls at Ostend.

text.p: Maastricht Handling will make a 15-16 million guilder investment proposal to the Belgian government next week to become the second freight handler at Ostend Airport .
The investment would take place over five years, director Maastricht Handling, Marco van de Kreeke, told Reuters.
Initially the Dutch company would use existing facilities at the Belgian airport but after a few years it would invest in new handling facilities.

As well as Maastricht Handling, which is the handler at Maastricht Aachen Airport in the south of the Netherlands, Aeroground Services of Schiphol and the UK's Servisair are interested in becoming cargo handlers at Ostend.
Belgian handling compnay, Belgavia is the main handler at Ostend, though some carriers do handle their own ground handling operations.

"We will offer the same quality of product that we do at Maastricht. Currently Ostend is not known to offer a high quality service. We are aiming to keep existing business and attract new high quality carriers," Van de Kreeke said.

Ostend specialises in non-scheduled freighter operators going to the Middle East and Africa, especially in the perishables business. Beans,and flowers, as well as cigarettes going to the CIS, are some of the major commodities handled at Ostend, he said. Last year, Ostend handled around 90,000 tonnes of cargo.
Maastricht Handling would also like to handle Ostend's passenger business but the issue at the moment concerns freight, he added.

Maastricht Handling is 100 percent owned by MAA which is in turn owned by the Dutch government. The company handles around 45,000 tonnes annually cargo-wise from carriers such as Royal Jordanian, Turkish Airlines, Iberia Cargo and Aerolineas Argentinas. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
